equity.level_reason: The only social-position dimension is sex (male vs female counts), with no social-position framing; sex alone stays at level 0.

level_alternative.reason: Sex-specific results are reported and contrasted ('twice as many'), which would be level 2 or 3 if sex were treated like other SPDs.

ev.q: During 1999–2020, there were generally twice as many deaths among males than among females each year.

notes: Counts have no population denominator, so outcomes are counts by year and sex. The 15,707 total only gives the series size. The significance claim likely rests on a trend test over years, but none is described.
view_issues: 'No statistically significant increase' is stated with no test, p-value, CI or method anywhere in the report.
